props.description: How far down, in pixels, before the button shows. Defaults to 400.
props.name: threshold

props.description: The button's accessible name. Defaults to the catalogue's "Back to top".
props.name: label

props.description: The scrolling element to watch and scroll; left out, the window. The button is then fixed to the viewport.
props.name: scrollRef

props.description:
The id of the element that takes focus once at the top, for example the skip link's target or the page's `h1`.
Left out, the scrolling element (or the body) does.
props.name: focusTargetId

props.description: Styles the button's wrapper, for example to move it above a bottom bar.
props.name: className
